co_plethora_boulder_right_gonad.blurb: A big, steep, overhanging sandstone boulder beside the highway in Unaweep Canyon, within the Bone Park group of boulders near Grand Junction. About eighteen problems are recorded, running from an easy V0 up to V11, with most of the weight in the V4 to V9 range, so it suits strong boulderers more than beginners. The lines on the east face are the draw, with solid, good-quality stone and several tall, committing problems and sit starts. Because the face looks east, it gets sun through the middle of the day in the busy season. The walk from the car is very short, which makes it an easy stop for a quick session.
co_plethora_boulder_right_gonad.parking_note: Pull off the highway beside the large pyramid-shaped Fossil Boulder on the right, a few miles up CO 141 from US 50 near Grand Junction. The Plethora boulder is just south of there, on the same side of the road.
